licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (fà; all' error, d'un alma, quest' ombre and quest' empia as two words each; the dots printed after Ei parte, senti, ah no, pose and colpe given as one ellipsis each).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 253–261, bars 1–154 of No. 25
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung line and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in three page ranges, pp. 253–255, 256–258 and 259–261), a separate sweep for dynamics, slurs and ties, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out. The accompanied recitative is bars 1–26 (bar 20, at a dotted barline, is set as 2/4); the Rondò starts at bar 27 with a 2/4 bar (Adagio, E major), Allegro moderato from bar 62. Not written in the score: two slurs in the right hand's lower voice (bars 135 and 137) that cross from one voice to another, the cut signs at “vi-” (bar 106) and “-de” (bar 121), and Peters' footnote at bars 66 and 96 that the autograph has G sharp where the print has A. Playback tempo: the recitative at ♩ = 66, the Adagio at ♩ = 40, the Allegro moderato at ♩ = 88, fitted to Jacobs (1:32 and 7:40); Mozart gives the words only.
